title.en: Never lose a change: Not sent yet and All changes saved
title.hi: Koi change na khoye: Not sent yet aur All changes saved
title.mr: Kuthlahi change harvu naye: Not sent yet aani All changes saved

description.en: Sales X-Ray keeps every change on your phone until it reaches us, then says All changes saved. Not sent yet means it's still on the phone: wait, or tap Try again. Never reinstall.
description.hi: Sales X-Ray har change aapke phone pe rakhta hai jab tak woh hum tak na pahunche, phir All changes saved dikhata hai. Not sent yet matlab abhi phone pe hai: rukiye, ya Try again dabaiye. Reinstall kabhi nahi.
description.mr: Sales X-Ray pratyek change tumchya phone var thevto jo paryant to aamchyaparyant pohochat nahi, mag All changes saved dakhavto. Not sent yet mhanje ajun phone var aahe: thamba, kinva Try again daba. Reinstall kadhich nako.

names.Can I show you in 10 minutes how: Can I quickly show you how

say.en: How Sales X-Ray keeps every change safe, even with a weak signal.
say.hi: Sales X-Ray हर change को कैसे safe रखता है, signal कमज़ोर हो तब भी.
say.mr: Sales X-Ray प्रत्येक change कसा safe ठेवतो, signal कमी असलं तरी.

latn.hi: Sales X-Ray har change ko kaise safe rakhta hai, signal kamzor ho tab bhi.
latn.mr: Sales X-Ray pratyek change kasa safe thevto, signal kami asla tari.

say.en: Next: Tasks, and reminders on any lead.
say.hi: अगले video में: Tasks, और किसी भी lead पे reminder.
say.mr: पुढच्या video मध्ये: Tasks, आणि कुठल्याही lead वर reminder.

latn.hi: Agle video mein: Tasks, aur kisi bhi lead pe reminder.
latn.mr: Pudhchya video madhye: Tasks, aani kuthlyahi lead var reminder.

text.en: Weak signal? Your work is safe

say.en: Weak signal? Your work is still safe. Here's how.
say.hi: Signal कमज़ोर? आपका काम फिर भी safe है. देखिए कैसे.
say.mr: Signal कमी? तुमचं काम तरीही safe आहे. बघा कसं.

latn.hi: Signal kamzor? Aapka kaam phir bhi safe hai. Dekhiye kaise.
latn.mr: Signal kami? Tumcha kaam tarihi safe aahe. Bagha kasa.

say.en: Every change you make, a note, a stage, a call log, is kept on your phone first, then sent to us.
say.hi: आप जो भी change करते हैं, note, stage, call log, वो पहले आपके phone पे रहता है, फिर हमें भेजा जाता है.
say.mr: तुम्ही जो काही change करता, note, stage, call log, तो आधी तुमच्या phone वर राहतो, मग आम्हाला पाठवला जातो.

latn.hi: Aap jo bhi change karte hain, note, stage, call log, woh pehle aapke phone pe rehta hai, phir humein bheja jaata hai.
latn.mr: Tumhi jo kahi change karta, note, stage, call log, to aadhi tumchya phone var rahto, mag aamhala pathavla jaato.

say.en: When it has reached us, you see All changes saved.
say.hi: जब वो हम तक पहुँच जाता है, तो All changes saved दिखता है.
say.mr: तो आमच्यापर्यंत पोहोचला की All changes saved दिसतं.

latn.hi: Jab woh hum tak pahunch jaata hai, toh All changes saved dikhta hai.
latn.mr: To aamchyaparyant pohochla ki All changes saved dista.

say.en: Not sent yet means it's still on your phone. It goes again by itself. You can also tap Try again.
say.hi: Not sent yet मतलब वो अभी आपके phone पे है. वो खुद दोबारा जाता है. आप Try again भी दबा सकते हैं.
say.mr: Not sent yet म्हणजे तो अजून तुमच्या phone वर आहे. तो स्वतः पुन्हा जातो. तुम्ही Try again पण दाबू शकता.

latn.hi: Not sent yet matlab woh abhi aapke phone pe hai. Woh khud dobara jaata hai. Aap Try again bhi daba sakte hain.
latn.mr: Not sent yet mhanje to ajun tumchya phone var aahe. To swatah punha jaato. Tumhi Try again pan dabu shakta.

say.en: Never uninstall the app while something is Not sent yet. Uninstalling deletes what's still on the phone.
say.hi: जब तक कुछ Not sent yet है, app कभी uninstall मत कीजिए. Uninstall करने से phone पे रखा काम मिट जाता है.
say.mr: जोपर्यंत काही Not sent yet आहे, app कधीच uninstall करू नका. Uninstall केल्याने phone वरचं काम जातं.

latn.hi: Jab tak kuch Not sent yet hai, app kabhi uninstall mat kijiye. Uninstall karne se phone pe rakha kaam mit jaata hai.
latn.mr: Joparyant kahi Not sent yet aahe, app kadhich uninstall karu naka. Uninstall kelyane phone varcha kaam jaata.

say.en: If a screen ever hangs, use Settings, Phone and alerts, Refresh app data. You stay signed in, and changes not sent yet are kept.
say.hi: अगर कोई screen अटक जाए, तो Settings, Phone and alerts में Refresh app data. आप signed in रहते हैं, और not sent yet वाले changes भी safe रहते हैं.
say.mr: एखादी screen अडकली, तर Settings, Phone and alerts मध्ये Refresh app data. तुम्ही signed in राहता, आणि not sent yet वाले changes पण safe राहतात.

latn.hi: Agar koi screen atak jaaye, toh Settings, Phone and alerts mein Refresh app data. Aap signed in rehte hain, aur not sent yet wale changes bhi safe rehte hain.
latn.mr: Ekhadi screen adakli, tar Settings, Phone and alerts madhye Refresh app data. Tumhi signed in rahta, aani not sent yet vale changes pan safe rahtat.
